title: polystichum unitum
intro: Polystichum unitum, commonly known as the Sword Fern, is a species of fern native to the Pacific coast of North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the relief of symptoms associated with bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of the Sword Fern are attributed to its antispasmodic, expectorant, and demulcent properties, which help to soothe and protect mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Polystichum unitum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
